entries.0de4a3130750bf80: Its strength lies in manufacturing based on technical capability built since the founding of its shipbuilding business in 1911. It manufactures a wide range of equipment within the group, including shot blasting machines, mechanical parking systems, emulsifying and agitating equipment, and switchboards, and handles design, construction, and maintenance consistently. Kodera Electronics Manufacturing Co., Ltd., which became a subsidiary in 2025, holds products with the top domestic share in fully automatic wire cutting and stripping machines. Its features also include that the holding company and the technical support company support the operating companies as a common platform for the group, and that it has expanded its business areas through M&A.

entries.91bd1aaef1e9c102: The Medium-Term Management Plan <'24-'26> is positioned as the first three years toward the vision for fiscal 2030, which marks the 10th anniversary of the new Sanoyas, and sets as key measures three priorities (strengthening solutions, challenging innovation, and advancing and deepening ESG management) together with strengthening the business foundation. For strengthening solutions, the company will actively invest in the industrial infrastructure and environmental fields as priority areas and nurture them into core businesses, expand overseas markets centered on Southeast Asia, and study M&A of companies or new business areas expected to create synergies with existing businesses. For challenging innovation, the company will use Sanoyas Techno Support Co., Ltd., a technology group, as a hub to actively pursue industry-academia collaboration and collaboration with other companies, aiming to create new businesses.
